//: Example .impeccable/config.json for a downstream project (copy to <repo>/.impeccable/config.json). Shared, committed waivers. Machine-local waivers go in .impeccable/config.local.json (gitignored). See ADR-A-0017 constraint 4 and scripts/design-system-check.sh.

detector.//ignoreRules: Fence the content/text rule class so it cannot false-positive on legitimate prose (ADR-A-0017 / ABS-191 §7.2). DOM rules (contrast, gray-on-color, palette, fonts) stay accurate and are NOT waived.

designSystem.//: Point the detector at the single design-contract source of truth (docs/design/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md); do NOT maintain an independent impeccable DESIGN.md.
